This surge was also fueled by a new multiyear fiber contract with AT&T valued at over USD 3 billion. The company reported strong Q2 2026 results and has an upcoming earnings report for Q3 2026 on November 3, 2026.

general_news.title: Verisk Analytics stock falls 2.67 percent before Q3 results
general_news.summary: Verisk Analytics' stock fell 2.67 percent to USD 163.88 on Nasdaq on October 2, 2026, ahead of its Q3 earnings report scheduled for November 5. This decline occurred despite the company beating Q2 adjusted EPS consensus and amid a fresh insider stock sale. Analysts have reset price targets lower, though the stock remains above its 52-week low.

general_news.title: Nordson Corp stock gains 1.37 percent near its yearly high
general_news.summary: Nordson Corp's stock gained 1.37 percent, reaching a price of USD 333.54, which is just 1.6 percent below its 52-week high. This surge follows a strong fiscal Q3 2026 performance where adjusted EPS and revenue both beat consensus estimates. The company also raised its full-year sales and adjusted EPS guidance, with analysts like Oppenheimer increasing their price targets.

general_news.title: Progressive Corp stock faces Q3 test as August premiums rise 6 percent
general_news.summary: Progressive Corp (PGR) saw August net premiums written rise 6 percent year over year to $7.605 billion, though net income fell 22 percent to $951 million. While policy growth continued, the combined ratio deteriorated, pointing to weaker underwriting efficiency. The company's upcoming Q3 results on October 21, 2026, will be a key indicator for investors, especially after a strong Q2 diluted EPS beat.

general_news.title: Allison Transmission redeems $100m of 2027 senior notes By Investing.com
general_news.summary: Allison Transmission Holdings Inc. (NYSE:ALSN) announced a partial redemption of $100 million of its 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027. The redemption was made at 100.00% of the principal amount plus accrued interest. Following this transaction, $300 million of the notes remain outstanding.

general_news.title: Booking Holdings stock reports 8.1 percent Q2 revenue growth
general_news.summary: Booking Holdings reported an 8.1% year-over-year revenue growth for Q2 2026, reaching $7.35 billion, and adjusted EPS of $2.54, both exceeding analyst estimates. However, management provided a more modest Q3 revenue growth guidance of 4% to 6%. The company also repurchased $7.4 billion in shares during the first half of 2026, and its stock closed at $159.02 on Nasdaq on October 2, 2026, below its 52-week high.

general_news.title: Automatic Data Processing stock falls 2.38 percent on October 2
general_news.summary: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) stock fell 2.38% on October 2, 2026, closing at USD 257.68 on Nasdaq. Despite the dip, analysts maintain a "Hold" consensus with an average target of USD 273.50. The company reported strong quarterly numbers, beating EPS consensus and achieving USD 5.47 billion in revenue, with its next earnings report scheduled for October 28, 2026.

general_news.title: Valero Energy stock reports 48.8 percent revenue growth
general_news.summary: Valero Energy reported a significant 48.8% revenue growth in Q2 2026, reaching USD 44.48 billion, with EPS at USD 12.54, beating consensus. Bank of America raised its price target for Valero to USD 414, while Goldman Sachs set an even higher target of USD 457. Investors are now looking forward to the Q3 2026 results, expected on October 22, to see if this momentum continues.

general_news.title: For vesting taxes, Alexandria Real Estate (ARE) withholds 1,068 CEO shares at $47.46 each.
general_news.summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. CEO Peter M. Moglia had 1,068 shares of common stock withheld by the issuer on September 30, 2026, to satisfy a tax obligation arising from the vesting of restricted stock. The shares were valued at $47.46 each, and following this transaction, his direct holdings amounted to 370,886 shares. This insider transaction is reported as having a neutral impact and sentiment.

general_news.title: Optional share sales carry a 3% commission under Silynxcom (SYNX)'s new agreement.
general_news.summary: Silynxcom Ltd. has entered into an at-the-market sales agreement with ThinkEquity LLC, allowing it to sell ordinary shares periodically. The company will pay a 3.0% commission on the aggregate gross proceeds from each sale and intends to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. Either party can terminate the agreement with five days' notice.
